events.title: Covert Koalas: Phasco at Expo Gamers 2026
events.summary: Almost the end of the week and here's a bit of news as well! Expo GamersFirst off - GameGlis team will be attending Expo Gamers tomorrow & on Saturday (29th & 30th May 2026) and we'll have our own booth. Anyone who comes will be able to play the latest version of the game, so be sure to drop by if you're nearby :)Progress updateNext, we consider the first level of the game to be complete, and currently working on the rest. We highly appreciate all player feedback gathered at the last live event

events.title: Covert Koalas: Phasco - game reveal & 1st live expo
events.summary: Game revealKoala fans around the world - rejoice! The world will this year become richer by one more game focused on koalas - Covert Koalas: Phasco. Why koalas? Well, they are cute, fluffy, and not very bright. What else do you need? :) When did the devs of this fine game come about with this idea? At the beginning of 2025.
